answers.answer_text: For wide toe box running shoes in Hong Kong, my top pick is the Altra Torin 7, which offers a roomy wide toe box and 2E/4E widths. Another good option is the New Balance Fresh Foam X 880v14 Wide. Topo Athletic is also popular with local runners. I would avoid the Nike Vaporfly 3 because it runs narrow in the forefoot.

When shopping for wide toe box running shoes, focus on fit first and look for a roomy wide toe box and 2E/4E widths. Brands such as Nike and adidas make models in this category, but availability in Hong Kong varies, so try shoes on at a specialist store. On balance, comfort matters more than any single feature.
